name: Emrakul's Messenger
oracle_text:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
Flying
Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}."
blocked_sentences: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}."

needs.what: a token id for a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}." -- e.g. `eldrazi_spawn_0_1_c`: types ["Creature"], subtypes ["Eldrazi", "Spawn"], power 0, toughness 1, colors [], color_identity [], is_token true, and one activated ability of its own, text "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}.", is_mana_ability true, cost {"sacrifice": {"zone": "battlefield", "controller": "you", "self_only": true, "count": 1}}, effects [{"op": "add_mana", "mana": "{C}"}] -- the treasure_token shape minus the tap and with a fixed colorless mana instead of the five-mode choose_mode. Every Eldrazi Spawn maker in the pool prints this same token, so the one id closes the whole family.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids is a closed list and contains no Eldrazi and no Spawn entry at all -- the nearest colorless creature tokens are `gnome_1_1_c` (1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature) and `hero_1_1_c` (1/1 colorless Hero creature), and both are the wrong size, the wrong creature type, and carry no ability, so neither is the printed token. The nearest token that makes mana is `treasure_token`, which is an artifact, taps, and adds one mana of any color rather than {C}. The brief forbids substituting a nearly-right token, and `create_token` takes only `token`, `amount`, `as`, `attacking`, `controller` and `tapped` in op_options -- it has no power/toughness, subtypes, colors or granted-ability override -- so the token's 0/1 body, its Eldrazi Spawn types and its own quoted sacrifice-for-{C} ability cannot be spelled from the card. `animate` and `add_subtype` could not fix it either: they would have to find the token after creation, and `create_token`'s `as` binding plus a follow-up effect would still be an approximation of a token the engine simply does not define.

notes: The token is the ONLY thing blocking this card -- everything else is expressible today, and the card ships the moment the one-line token id lands. The rest spells out as: card id `emrakul_s_messenger`, name "Emrakul's Messenger", mana_cost "{1}{U}", types ["Creature"], subtypes ["Eldrazi", "Faerie", "Rogue"], power 2, toughness 1, keywords ["flying"], and -- this is the Devoid line -- colors [] with color_identity ["U"], exactly how the shipped `vestige_of_emrakul` writes "Devoid (This card has no color.)" with no ability at all. The single ability is triggered, text "Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with \"Sacrifice this token: Add {C}.\"", trigger {"event": "draw", "controller": "you", "nth": 2}, effects [{"op": "create_token", "token": "<the new eldrazi_spawn_0_1_c id>"}] -- byte-for-byte the shape shipped `prince_imrahil_the_fair` already uses for "Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.", so `nth: 2` is proven and needs nothing new. Expectation would be {"zone": "battlefield", "battlefield_count": 33}: nothing in the sandbox position draws a card after the creature resolves, so the trigger never fires and no `tokens` assertion is available -- only the creature arriving on the battlefield can be asserted.
